# Pull Request

## Summary

- Describe the change and which part of the retirement effort it supports.

## Phase

- [ ] 1 - Assess (find exposure)
- [ ] 2 - Migrate (drive adoption)
- [ ] 3 - Verify (confirm completion)
- [ ] Documentation only

## Validation

- [ ] Query was run against a real workspace and returns what the title claims.
- [ ] Metadata header is complete (Title, Platform, Phase, Tags, Description,
      Data sources, Parameters, Notes).
- [ ] Success filtering applied (`ResultType` and `succeeded`).
- [ ] Users identified by `UserId`, not `Identity`.
- [ ] Methods classified and aggregated before filtering, with an
      `Unclassified` bucket surfaced.
- [ ] Any date or scope claim checked against the Microsoft retirement
      guidance, including which users fall under February versus July.
- [ ] No tenant identifiers, real domain names, user names or object IDs.

## Notes

Schema assumptions, required permissions, or validation limitations.
